title: The SDET Architect — Field Guide
eyebrow: Plate 45 · a field guide of its own
footer: The SDET Architect · code in [forward-qa-agents](https://github.com/akc031185/forward-qa-agents) · companion guides: [The Forward Deployed Tester](https://akc031185.github.io/forward-deployed-tester/) and the [QA Agents field guide](https://akc031185.github.io/qa-agents/).
heroH1: Whatever tests an organisation already has, rebuilt as one Playwright architecture.
heroLead: Point it at a folder of Selenium in Java, Python, C# or JavaScript, Cucumber features, Postman collections and markdown test plans.
It parses all of it into one model, standardises every locator with a confidence score, and generates one Playwright + Playwright MCP project.
`MIGRATION.md` lists every line it could not convert with its source `file:line`. The human work is the TODO list, not the reading.
primerP: Regex and line-based parsers only: no AST libraries, no Java, Python or .NET toolchain needed.
Byte-for-byte deterministic with `LLM_PROVIDER=none`; a local model may only add `suggestion:` comments next to TODOs.
Findings in five categories (locator, conversion, flakiness, duplication, quality) and one artifact row per generated file.
A preview route converts a single file with no disk and no database.
